name: fable5
description: Commander-mode operating discipline: the main model acts as advisor/dispatcher — it converses, decides, delegates, and integrates, while heavy execution (large reads, repo scans, batch edits) goes to subagents that return only conclusions. Bundles the founding prompt for spending one strong-model session to externalize judgment into rule files a weaker model can follow long-term. Harness-specific and self-canonical: it names model tiers, dispatches via a subagent tool, and writes its output into a per-user config home, so it has no harness-neutral playbook counterpart.
